summary: The Power link crew's spots (powerLink.ts formation()) move into a pure formationSpots() that keeps every spot inside the plan's frontier rectangle (the board), trying the centre-ward end, the far end, then the other axis, then clamping; on board beats plates; the board reaches it through CastViews.board from GraphScene.solarBoard().
notes: Scope 'Today'/'Touches' name placeFormation.ts (a planet's pieces); the captain formation is powerLink.ts formation(). Packet corrects this; no scope edit made.

Design choice: the board is the plan's frontier rectangle, not the camera's fit. boundsOf always includes it, so inside it implies inside the fitted bounds, and it is scale-free so seek and play agree (the Decided line).

Risk: the unchanged rule may already pass at plan level (it already prefers the star's side); the packet tells the builder to record that honestly rather than invent a bug. The unit test's no-board mode reproduces today's output, so nothing outside a solar region moves.
D3 will extend the candidate list in formationSpots (on-board slots first), per the 2026-11-01 priority decision.
CastViews gains a non-role key (board): the builder must grep for code iterating CastViews by key before adding it.
